login.title: Sign in
login.redirecting: Taking you to the sign-in page…
login.signedOut: You are signed out. All products share one sign-in, so the other products are signed out too.
login.passwordChanged: Your password was changed and every device was signed out. Sign in again with the new password.
login.logoutIncomplete: Signing out on the server did not complete: other products and the sign-in service may still be signed in, and the next person on this computer could be signed in as you. Please retry; on a shared computer, close the browser.
login.endIdpSession: Sign out at the sign-in service

callback.title: Sign in
callback.failed: Sign-in did not complete; the link may have expired or already been used. Please sign in again.

interaction.for: Sign in to continue to “{{client}}”. All products share this account.
interaction.forTenant: Sign in to “{{tenant}}” to continue to “{{client}}”.
interaction.forPlatform: Sign in with your platform administrator account.
interaction.enterTenant: Signing in to your workspace? Enter your tenant code

error.title: Can't sign in
error.invalidRedirectUri: This site is not registered to use platform sign-in.
error.invalidRequest: The sign-in request is malformed. Go back to the site and sign in again.
error.generic: Something went wrong while signing in. Go back to the site and sign in again.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we will send a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If that email exists in the system, a reset link has been sent.

register.title: Request an account
register.description: An administrator will review your request. Once approved, sign in with this email and password.
register.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. your team and what you need access to (optional)
register.submitted: Request submitted. Once an administrator approves it, you can sign in with the email and password you just set.
register.closed: This tenant is not accepting registration requests. Ask an administrator to create an account for you.

password.hint: At least {{min}} characters and not a common password.

login.tenantRequired: We could not tell which tenant this account belongs to. Open this page from your tenant’s sign-in page or the link in the email.

enterTenant.title: Go to your tenant
enterTenant.description: Enter your tenant code to sign in to your workspace.

login.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
